name: Ayyappa
reason: Widely given South Indian boy's name after the deity of Sabarimala, son of Shiva and Mohini (Vishnu); meaning acceptable.

name: Haridas
reason: Classic Vaishnava boy's name, servant of Hari (Vishnu); meaning correct.

name: Kamalnayan
reason: Common Vishnu/Krishna-linked name, lotus-eyed; meaning correct.

name: Saravana
reason: Devanagari was misspelled; the sibilant should be palatal, so शरवण matches IAST śaravaṇa.

fix.meaning_en: Born in the reed thicket (śara-vana); a name of Kartikeya/Murugan, son of Shiva.

name: Shashishekhar
reason: Established Shiva name, moon-crested; script and meaning correct.

name: Siddhidata
reason: Descriptive epithet of Ganesha (and close to Siddhidatri, a form of Durga), not a standard personal name for a boy.
